numerical_implementation_notes: Inherited E16 learners with unchanged model menus, RKNN training/checkpoint state and prototype construction. Warning messages/counts are run-length encoded in original order, avoiding repeated identical JSON strings.

Ridge Euclidean-simplex projection uses equivalent row-max translation before sorting to avoid cancellation for extreme extrapolated logits. Verified against constrained optimization and analytic large-scale example, synthetic only.
Every inner encoder is fit on its own training text, with explicit held-fold canary check. Shared fitted text axes have no semantic-token interpretation.
17policies per case,105real CV candidates,20predeclared cases; all predictions/failures freeze before scoring. No G_oneSE or additional ProLSFEO run.
Deployment file bytes sum estimator JSON/NPZ and required shared encoder JSON/NPZ. Mean-only model omits encoder. This is not peak runtime memory.
state_export: Portable plain JSON vocabulary plus IDF/SVD NPZ; estimator arrays and scalar metadata separate; no pickled code. SHA checked on resume.
outer_failure_policy: Case failures frozen with no alternate split. Complete-family directional criterion cannot be met when primary cases missing. Code assertions abort for diagnosis rather than becoming favorable scientific outcomes.
technical_test_scope: Synthetic144objects only, RKNN1/2epoch checkpoints; real study100/500/1000. No new-task feature/model fitting or predictive outcome scored before source freeze.
environment: Python3.12, numpy2.3.5, scipy1.17, sklearn1.8, torch2.9.1+cpu/keras3.12.0; one BLAS thread, two process workers.
pipeline: Local-only runner -> global20case freeze -> independent encoder/state/CV/metric audit -> aggregate reports/private archives; connector uploads/publication/manuscript edits remain separate authorized steps.
